parameter_semantics: object_pose_field selects the observed manipulated block whose fresh world position anchors the low-motion translation candidate and supplies clearance; destination_pose_field selects the fresh observed SE(3) drawer destination for the post-clear candidate; tunnel_clearance_m is the fixed world-z tunnel roof height in metres. Bindings use object_pose, target_pose and 0.16.
output_semantics: Each slot is [world-axis TCP translation offset from fresh object position in metres (3), absolute world TCP rotation 6D (6), destination-frame TCP translation in metres (3), destination-frame TCP rotation 6D (6), shared gripper scalar (1)]. Both branches represent the same demonstrated Cartesian command. decode reconstructs both from fresh object_pose and target_pose. Let c=object_center_z-object_half_m-tunnel_clearance_m; destination weight is clip(c/0.04,0,1). Positions are linearly blended and rotations are blended on SO(3) from the object candidate to the destination candidate. The world target is converted only by panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured joints. Gripper >=0 opens and <0 closes. Slots are t-1 through t+14 and execution uses slots 1 through 8.

conversion_check.description: Both encoded candidates independently recover the demonstrated commanded FK TCP pose. Their clearance blend must therefore recover that same pose and shared gripper within 0.01 maximum metres/radians/scalar; nonunique IK is accepted only through the independent task-space comparison and diagnostics expose all residuals.

cut_relation: Keeps every action in each [300,840) binding, including action-supervised predecessor overlap [300,440) and successor overlap [680,840). The analytic 0.04 m clearance blend changes only the reference used to decode learned Cartesian targets and adds no task waypoint or recovery script.
